title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Get answers to the most common questions about Lyyli.ai's AI communication platform, security, GDPR compliance, and integrations.

faqs.question: What is Lyyli.ai and how does it work?
faqs.answer: Lyyli.ai is an AI-powered communication platform that transforms how professional service organizations communicate. It analyzes your communication patterns, identifies opportunities for improvement, and provides intelligent suggestions to enhance customer interactions. The platform integrates seamlessly with your existing tools and provides real-time insights to help your team communicate more effectively.

faqs.question: What security measures does Lyyli.ai implement?
faqs.answer: Lyyli.ai implements enterprise-grade security including end-to-end encryption, SOC 2 Type II compliance, regular security audits, and ISO 27001 certification. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with role-based access controls and multi-factor authentication. We conduct regular penetration testing and maintain strict data governance policies to ensure your information remains secure.

faqs.question: Is Lyyli.ai GDPR compliant?
faqs.answer: Yes, Lyyli.ai is fully GDPR compliant. We provide data processing agreements, support data portability, implement privacy by design, and offer easy data deletion upon request. Our platform includes consent management tools, data minimization practices, and regular compliance audits. We act as both data controller and processor as needed, with clear data handling procedures.

faqs.question: Where is my data stored and processed?
faqs.answer: Your data is stored in secure, GDPR-compliant data centers located within the European Union. We use AWS and Microsoft Azure infrastructure with servers in Ireland, Germany, and Finland. All data processing occurs within EU borders unless explicitly requested otherwise, ensuring compliance with local data protection regulations.

faqs.question: What integrations does Lyyli.ai support?
faqs.answer: Lyyli.ai integrates with popular business tools including Microsoft Teams, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, and Google Workspace. We offer REST APIs, webhooks, and pre-built connectors for seamless data flow. Custom integrations can be developed for specific needs, and our platform supports single sign-on (SSO) with most identity providers.

faqs.question: How long does implementation take?
faqs.answer: Typical implementation takes 2-4 weeks depending on your organization's size and complexity. The process includes data migration, user training, integration setup, and testing. We provide dedicated onboarding support, comprehensive documentation, and training sessions for your team. Most organizations see value within the first month of deployment.

faqs.question: How does Lyyli.ai pricing work?
faqs.answer: Lyyli.ai offers flexible pricing based on the number of users and features needed. We provide transparent, per-user pricing with no hidden fees. Enterprise plans include custom features, dedicated support, and volume discounts. All plans include core functionality, security features, and regular updates. Contact our sales team for a customized quote based on your specific requirements.

faqs.question: What support is available?
faqs.answer: We provide comprehensive support including 24/7 technical support, dedicated customer success managers for enterprise clients, extensive documentation, video tutorials, and regular webinars. Our support team is available via email, chat, and phone. Enterprise customers receive priority support with faster response times and dedicated account management.

faqs.question: Can Lyyli.ai be customized for our needs?
faqs.answer: Yes, Lyyli.ai offers extensive customization options including custom workflows, branded interfaces, tailored reporting dashboards, and industry-specific templates. Our enterprise plans include white-labeling options, custom integrations, and dedicated development resources. We work closely with your team to ensure the platform meets your specific business requirements.

faqs.question: What ROI can we expect from Lyyli.ai?
faqs.answer: Organizations typically see 25-40% improvement in communication efficiency, 30% reduction in response times, and 20% increase in customer satisfaction within 6 months. Our ROI calculator helps estimate specific benefits for your organization. We provide detailed analytics and reporting to track your progress and demonstrate value realization.
